narrative: KVP36-2342D-0300 threw a DC ground fault alarm. Isolated the fault down to CB-B06-02. Found a home run that had chafed through against the rack upright, the insulation was worn right down to the conductor. Repaired the run and resecured it clear of the steel with a proper standoff rather than just a tie. Unit returned to service and the fault has not recurred.
